scope: Read-only snapshot of the fourteen issue-first PRs. No CI success or upstream acceptance is inferred.
pr_state: All fourteen remain open at their audited heads; core PR 54 is draft. Apple PR 4842 and Osaurus core PR 54 had no commit check rollup.

passed_on_all_twelve: Linux CMake bookworm and fedora39 aarch64 and x86_64
vmlx_checks.lint_policy: Advisory (continue-on-error) in the pinned upstream pull_request.yml.

lint_evidence.finding: The latest-release lookup left SWIFT_FORMAT_VERSION empty; the checkout then failed with repository '1' before any formatter ran. The empty output is proved by the rendered clone command; the HTTP response behind it is not recorded.
The Swift and CMake hooks produced 1087 file diffs, including the PR paths and unrelated paths. The other ten lint jobs failed at the same step; their full diffs were not individually attributed.
An unrelated upstream PR reproduced repository-wide formatter churn (1091 diffs). Upstream already tracks it in issue 400. This is not proof every changed file in our PRs is individually style-clean.

disposition: Do not mix unrelated baseline formatting into atomic runtime PRs. No branch changes or rerun requests were sent. Release qualification remains the separate exact local artifact gate.
